pm_exper_user_2614_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Try mango lassi — blend ripe mango with yogurt, a touch of honey and a pinch of cardamom for a silky, chilled drink; serve immediately over ice. It takes about 20 minutes and you can finish with a few fresh rose petals from your garden.
(b) Try rose-cardamom poached pears with dairy-free coconut yogurt — gently poach halved pears in a spiced syrup with cardamom and orange, then serve warm over coconut yogurt with crushed pistachios. It takes about 20 minutes and you can finish with a few fresh rose petals from your garden.
(c) Try baked apples with cinnamon and chopped nuts — core apples, stuff with a mix of chopped nuts, honey and cinnamon, then bake until tender. It takes about 20 minutes and you can finish with a few fresh rose petals from your garden.
(d) Try dark chocolate molten cakes with vanilla ice cream — bake individual cakes in ramekins until the centers are runny, then serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a light dusting of cocoa. It takes about 20 minutes and you can finish with a few fresh rose petals from your garden.
